title: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 Anti-Wrinkle Serum

seo.title: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 10% Anti-Wrinkle Serum
seo.description: 10% Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 serum. Nearly 1 in 2 saw clearly smoother crow's feet in 4 weeks in a double-blind study. On placebo: no one.

description_html:
A targeted peptide serum that helps visibly relax the look of expression lines around the eyes and forehead.

  • Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 - 10%, the concentration used in the clinical studies
  • Helps soften the look of forehead lines, crow's feet and frown lines
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: expression lines on the forehead and around the eyes, and anyone wanting a gentle, preventative anti-aging step.

Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 is the peptide also known by the trade name Argireline®, a registered trademark of Lubrizol.
custom.key_benefits:
- Relaxes the look of lines - helps visibly soften expression lines around the eyes and forehead
- Smoother appearance - for a smoother, more refreshed look over time
- Lightweight & layerable - absorbs quickly and sits well under moisturiser
- Hydration - hyaluronic acid for a smoother, hydrated feel
What to expect: in the clinical trial, nearly 1 in 2 people were graded clearly smoother around the eyes after 4 weeks of twice-daily use of 10% Acetyl Hexapeptide-8.
custom.how_to_use:
Use morning and evening. After cleansing, press 3-4 drops onto slightly damp skin, focusing on expression-line areas - the forehead, around the eyes and between the brows. Pat in gently (don't rub), wait about a minute, then follow with your moisturiser and, in the morning, SPF.
Best results build with consistent daily use over several weeks.
Complete the routine: follow with a moisturiser such as the Matrixyl 3000 Pro-Collagen Firming Cream or the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Day Gel-Cream, plus SPF in the morning.
custom.clinical_research:
Nearly 1 in 2 saw clearly smoother-looking crow's feet in 4 weeks. On placebo: no one.
Our serum contains 10% Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, the level used in the clinical trials:
- 22 of 45 people graded clearly improved after 4 weeks of twice-daily use, vs 0 of 15 on placebo
- Measurably smoother skin around the eyes, confirmed on silicone skin replicas
- Forehead roughness down 7.4% by day 20, while it rose on placebo
- Well tolerated: no side effects reported in the controlled studies
Wang et al. 2013, Am J Clin Dermatol: double-blind, placebo-controlled, 60 adults, 10% Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 twice daily for 4 weeks. 48.9% is the share of people graded improved, not a wrinkle reduction. Raikou et al. 2017, J Cosmet Dermatol. Results describe the ingredient.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 Anti-Wrinkle Serum do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A peptide serum with Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, supporting peptides, niacinamide and ectoin. It helps relax the look of expression lines for smoother-looking skin over time.

custom.faq_items.question: What is Acetyl Hexapeptide-8?
custom.faq_items.answer: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 is a peptide widely used in skincare and studied for helping to relax the appearance of expression lines such as crow's feet and forehead lines.

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I use it?
custom.faq_items.answer: Use morning and/or evening on clean skin. Apply a few drops focusing on expression lines (forehead, around the eyes), let it absorb, then follow with moisturiser and SPF 30+ in the morning.

custom.faq_items.question: How soon will I see results?
custom.faq_items.answer: A smoother look to expression lines typically builds over about 4 weeks of consistent twice-daily use.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I combine it with other Skingenetix serums?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. It pairs well with the Copper Peptide or Matrixyl 3000 serums, targeting expression lines while they support firmness and smoothness.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance, and it includes ectoin, a soothing hydration ingredient. We recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 Serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply a few drops to expression lines: forehead, crow's feet and around the mouth. Wait 60 seconds.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Moisturise + SPF
custom.how_to_steps.description: Follow with your moisturiser. Finish with SPF 30+ every morning.
